correctness.rationale: Exact independent construction and exhaustive standard-library certificate reconstruct all 4096 faces, 420 cut facets and 75 dual tetrahedra, validate 75 genuine elementary free-triangle collapses and ten automorphism conjugacy classes. The dual then becomes a simply connected two-complex with reduced Euler characteristic 90, hence 90 integral 2-spheres. Alexander duality, six-skeleton connectivity and Whitehead yield 90 integral 7-spheres for the original; reduced Hopf traces and an independent dual trace cross-check give three rational invariants. No finite-to-infinite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The closest same-graph publication handles total four-cuts (45 independent sets), not ordinary four-cuts (420 disconnected sets), and gives 43 degree-four spheres with zero full-group invariants. The known uniform ordinary four-cut theorem requires girth at least five, whereas Franklin has three four-cycles. Inspected ordinary/total foundational manuscripts, a sequel, and matched published results do not imply the new rank, integral homotopy or character; unindexed equivalent work remains a risk.

value.rationale: A canonical cubic bipartite graph with three four-cycles lies just beyond the girth-five classification. The exact integral homotopy and all ten rational character values, including a three-dimensional invariant space, distinguish ordinary cut topology from the already studied total cut topology. The full finite collapse and symmetry certificates supply reusable nontrivial mathematical data, not an arbitrary unmotivated numerical slice.
